sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234791 (public search API, 13 sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234791 (all 13 sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234791 ('Water is not a fill station... Please come with your RV water full'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 13 sites, 7 reservable and 6 walk-up (the Forest Service page still says 14). Paved roads and parking spurs; max trailer length 40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234791 ('This location has 13 campsites, 7 which are reservable and 6 that are walk-up sites', 'Campground roads and parking spurs are paved') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/devil-creek-campground ('Max trailer length is 40 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from 4 spigots for filling jugs only, not an RV fill station. Firewood and trash collection.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234791 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. Water is not a fill station. There are 4 water spigots throughout the campground for filling jugs. Please come with your RV water full.'; amenities 'Firewood', 'Trash Collection'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/devil-creek-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Memorial Day Weekend - September'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run in summer by the concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. 7 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 6 walk-up; reservations close 4 days before arrival. 16 consecutive nights, 32 nights a year. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234791 ('13 campsites, 7 which are reservable and 6 that are walk-up sites. The stay limit is 16 consecutive nights.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights Each Year, reservationCutOff 4) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/devil-creek-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months', '16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF (Hungry Horse-Glacier View RD) campground in heavy conifer forest beside US-2, ~32 mi SE of West Glacier and 6 mi west of Marias Pass, 4360 ft; Devil Creek Trail #167 into the Great Bear/Spotted Bear country. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 (2026 rate table; fees left as recorded), no electric, 13 sites (7 reservable, 6 walk-up), 40-ft max trailer, vault toilets and drinking water. Added the Memorial Day-September season, 16-night limit and concessionaire. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (derived 'none' left; rec.gov says to arrive with RV water full), booking window (left inherited). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: the concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds, (406) 752-7924 (recreation.gov and the Forest Service page); ranger station (406) 387-3800. Concession-run in summer (Flathead Valley Campgrounds, flatheadvalleycampgrounds.com), part walk-up.

Forest Service page is stale (last updated April 2025): it lists $16 single / $32 double, 14 sites, and says both 'drinking water are provided' and 'Potable water is not available at this site'. recreation.gov's 2025-2027 rate table says $22, so the recorded fee stands.
